preamble: Voicing and deaffrication of the postalveolar ejective affricate [tʃʼ] to [ʒ]. In Chechen and Ingush, non-initial Proto-Nakh *tʃʼ (kept in Bats) appears as ж, parallel to *tsʼ > z. Starling transcribes the reflex as ž; whether it was [ʒ] or [dʒ] at an intermediate stage is not settled.
